entities.name: Strasbourg–Basel railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The railway from Strasbourg to Basel is a French and Swiss 141.3-kilometre long railway line. It is used for passenger and freight traffic. The railway was opened in 1840–1844. It was the first railway line to serve Switzerland.
